## Checklist

- [ ] `pnpm format:check`, `pnpm lint`, `pnpm typecheck`, `pnpm test` and `pnpm build` pass
- [ ] Added a changeset (`pnpm changeset`) if a published package changes
- [ ] Tests cover the change
- [ ] A `.dbml` file is never changed beyond the user's edit (round-trip stays byte-identical otherwise)
- [ ] Docs updated if behaviour or public API changed
